gatewaySettings.title: Gateway Settings
gatewaySettings.description: Configure local Gateway host, auth toggle and default API Key
gatewaySettings.hostLanHint: Set to 0.0.0.0 (allow LAN access, mind security)
gatewaySettings.authEnabledHelpContent:
Controls whether external requests need an API Key to access the gateway.

On: External requests must carry a valid API Key (default Gateway Key or records in API Key Management).
Off: Open mode, external requests can access without authentication.

Note: Internal CLI is exempted via the inner-cli-api header and is not affected by this toggle. The default API Key only takes effect when auth is enabled; it does not control the auth toggle.
gatewaySettings.defaultApiKeyPlaceholder: Leave empty to use API Key Management records
gatewaySettings.defaultApiKeyDisabledHint: Auth disabled, default API Key not in effect
gatewaySettings.deepseekFixHelpContent:
In DeepSeek V4 thinking mode, all assistant messages in multi-turn conversations must include the reasoning_content field. However, the model sometimes returns only tool_calls without producing reasoning_content, causing the next request to be rejected with a 400 error.

When enabled, the gateway automatically injects an empty reasoning_content as fallback for assistant messages of matching models.

Matching: case-insensitive match against the gateway model ID (e.g. provider_slug/model_id) using the keyword and match mode.

callbackServer.title: Callback Servers
callbackServer.description: View active OAuth callback server instances
callbackServer.helpContent:
During OAuth 2.0 authorization, i-code starts a local HTTP server to receive browser callbacks.

Fixed-port providers (Claude Code: 54545, OpenAI Codex: 1455, xAI: 56121) use preset ports; other providers use dynamically assigned ports.

Servers auto-close on callback receipt or 120s timeout. If a port is occupied, you can force-close stale instances here.
